title: ICFAI Bangalore Pro Vice Chancellor Dr. Muddu Vinay Inducted into Dual Fellowship Vanguard for Sustainability
summary: Dr. Muddu Vinay of the ICFAI Foundation for Higher Education, Bangalore, was honoured at the 2nd Global Professional Fellowship graduation spanning 39 nations.
body_html:
Bengaluru, 6 November 2026: Dr. Muddu Vinay, Pro Vice Chancellor of the ICFAI Foundation for Higher Education, Bangalore, has been honoured among an elite group of global fellows inducted into The Dual Fellowship Vanguard. The recognition was announced at the virtual graduation ceremony of the 2nd Global Professional Fellowship programme, hosted by Global Ambassadors of Sustainability and The Green Chamber of Commerce.

The graduation ceremony celebrated purpose-driven leaders from both the Global South and the Global North who are working to bring about change in sustainable development. The fellowship cohort spanned 39 nations, bringing together participants from a wide range of countries in a shared, cross-border effort.

A central feature of this year's graduation was the introduction of The Dual Fellowship Vanguard. The new recognition honours fellows who have achieved the rare distinction of completing both the Professional Sustainability Fellowship (PSF) and the Distinguished Professional Sustainability Fellowship (D-PSF). Dr. Vinay was named among this group of inductees.

According to the organisers, India had prominent representation among the global inductees, reflecting the country's growing leadership in climate action and sustainable practices. Dr. Vinay's inclusion was described as highlighting the important role that academic leadership plays in developing sustainable solutions.

The ceremony featured addresses from international sustainability leaders, led by Dr. Wesam Al Madhoun, CEO & Founder of Global Ambassadors of Sustainability, and Ms. Michelle Thatcher, CEO & Founder of the Global Green Chamber of Commerce. In their remarks, the speakers stressed the value of cross-border mentorship and collaborative leadership in tackling present-day environmental challenges.

Speaking on behalf of the graduating cohort, a representative said, "This milestone genuinely reflects the remarkable commitment of fellows worldwide." The representative added, "Together, we exemplify that the pursuit of excellence and sustainable development transcends borders."

Global Ambassadors of Sustainability thanked the speakers, mentors, organisers and members of the cohort for their dedication throughout the fellowship programme, which concluded with this graduation ceremony.
